contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!

The new patch notes for today!
We have enabled Cloud Saves and fixed many bugs.


<size=150%>Version EA_0.10:</size>

- Cloud saves are enabled!
- Mittens now protect from rash when extracting Fibers.
- All traps can now be stacked and unstacked.
- Smokehouse now has an extinguish button.
- Basic Trapping Quest now requires you to only catch 1 non specific Animal.
- Compost Bin now dismantles into Planks instead of Wood.
- Cellar now gives discomfort only if player is in the Cellar.
- Boiled Forest Caps, Meat, Fish Meat and Bird Meat now appear in the Food Filter.
- Leather Shoes and Trousers now properly hide their wetness.
- Antler no longer drops items when it breaks apart.
- Smokehouse no longer reduces player Stealth Value while being away from it.
- Fishing Bait will not accept boiled Meat.
- Tourniquets no longer cause pain when they are inside an equipped Bag.
- Tweaked Turnroot calories.
- Added art for the Embers.

Have a good day/night everyone and see you in the next patch!
contents.Text:
大家好！

今日份的更新日志！
我们开启了steam云存档并修复了许多bug。

<size=150%>版本EA_0.10：</size>


- Steam云存档已启用！
- 毛皮手套现在可以在提取纤维时防止皮疹。
- 所有陷阱现在可以堆叠和拆分。
- 烟熏屋现在可以主动熄灭。
- 基础陷阱任务现在只要求您捕捉一只任意动物。
- 堆肥箱现在在拆解时会返还木板而不是木头。
- 现在只有玩家身处地窖时，地窖才会让游戏角色感到不适。
- 煮熟的森伞盖、肉、鱼肉和鸟肉现在出现在食物过滤器中。
- 皮革鞋子和裤子现在可以正确隐藏其湿度。
- 鹿角损坏时不再掉落物品。
- 烟熏屋不再在玩家远离时降低玩家的潜行值。
- 鱼饵蓝图不再接受煮熟的肉。
- 将止血带放在已装备的袋子中时不再造成疼痛。
- 调整了翻根的卡路里值。
- 为火碳添加了图片。

祝大家有个美好的一天/夜晚，我们下次更新再见！
